controlling_conclusion.es: No es conexión cero y no es el mismo dinero: la deuda pública y RICPE son vías paralelas de materialización RIC; el vínculo directo con Acosta Matos está en RICPE hacia HNT, no en una asignación probada de los bonos públicos.
controlling_conclusion.en: The connection is not zero and the money is not the same: public debt and RICPE are parallel RIC materialisation routes; the direct Acosta Matos link is RICPE to HNT, not a proved allocation of public-bond proceeds.

findings.proposition: The 2024 and 2025 RIC-eligible public issues allocated EUR 250 million against EUR 1.139779 billion of demand.
The public issues finance qualifying public investment and are legally separate from RICPE Series F/G financing to HNT.
The 2024 and 2025 bonds post-date the December 2022 and June 2023 HNT loans and therefore cannot be their original source.
The public debt route is a market-capacity and institutional-process comparator for the private RICPE route within one RIC policy ecosystem.
Whether an Acosta Matos person or entity subscribed to either public issue cannot be determined from the dissociated production.
